title: Quote
description: A programming quote in the corpus.

id.description: Alias of `_id` for client convenience (some mirrors expose this).

en.description: English quote text (legacy multilingual field, may be absent on the current API).

text.description: Quote text. The current canonical API exposes this field; legacy multilingual deployments use `en`/`sr`/etc.

source.description: Optional source citation for the quote (book, talk, blog post).
source.example: EWD498 — How do we tell truths that might hurt?

numberOfVotes.description: Count of votes that contributed to the rating.
